sections.title: Unit 23: Urbanism in Crisis: Agglomeration Sprawl, Transit & Brownfield Renewal
body: Metropolitan Budapest faces unprecedented structural crises: explosive suburban sprawl chokeholds, car dependency gridlocks, conflicts over City Park development, public transport underfunding, and brownfield gentrification.

In this unit, you will master the elevated discourse of urban conflict framing, statutory zoning mandates, proportional commuter mobility, and participatory urbanism in contemporary Hungarian civic life.
